$$f'(x)=\frac{1\cdot(x+2)-(x+3)\cdot1}{(x+2)^2}=\frac{-1}{(x+2)^2}.$$

$$f'(x)=\frac{1\cdot(x+2)-(x+3)\cdot1}{(x+2)^2}=\frac{-1}{(x+2)^2}.$$
